description: ZERO-RETENTION MULTIMODAL ATTESTOR. Ingests an artifact_sha256 or ephemeral document payload (PDF invoice text, bank-change letter, or ISO 20022 pain.001 XML) in Worker RAM, verifies statutory bank/tax checksums (MOD-97 IBAN, MOD-36 GSTIN, MOD-97-10 LEI), discards raw PII immediately, and emits a signed RFC 8785 XDR-1 Decision Receipt.

artifact_sha256.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the commercial invoice or ISO 20022 XML artifact

document_text.description: Optional ephemeral text/XML stream parsed in RAM and discarded immediately

extracted_iban.description: Extracted beneficiary IBAN or settlement wallet

extracted_tax_id.description: Extracted VAT, NIP, GSTIN, CRN, or LEI identifier

name: attest_document_integrity
